parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

😎
acid[æsid]n.
An acid is a chemical that can burn or dissolve other substances.
→ In chemistry class, we mixed two acids together and watched the reaction.
😎
administration[ədminəstreiʃən]n.
An administration is the group of people who manage a company or organization.
→ She hoped she could be promoted to a job in the administration.
😎
administrative[ədminəstreitiv]adj.
Administrative describes anything related to managing a company or organization.
→ I work as an administrative assistant to the owner of the company.
😎
biotechnology[baiouteknɑlədʒi]n.
Biotechnology is the use of living parts, such as cells, in industry and technology.
→ Researchers at the biotechnology company use bacteria to make medicine.
😎
cholesterol[kəlestəroul]n.
Cholesterol is a substance in fat, tissues, and blood of all animals.
→ When people have too much cholesterol, they are at a high risk for heart problems.
😎
coalition[kouəliʃən]n.
A coalition is a group of people or organizations working for a common purpose.
→ The companies formed a coalition to make trade less expensive.
😎
deceptive[diseptiv]adj.
When something is deceptive, it encourages one to believe something that is false.
→ The scary-looking man’s appearance is deceptive, but he is actually very nice.
😎
diabetes[daiəbi:tis]n.
Diabetes is a medical condition where a person has too much sugar in their blood.
→ Overweight people are more likely to suffer from diabetes than slimmer ones.
😎
eliminate[ilimineit]v.
To eliminate something that is unwanted means to completely remove it.
→ Wearing a seatbelt eliminates some of the dangers of driving a car.
😎
erosion[irouʒən]n.
Erosion is the destruction of rock or soil due to flowing water or weather.
→ Canyons are formed because rivers of fast-moving water caused erosion.
😎
ethics[eθiks]n.
Ethics are moral beliefs or rules about right or wrong.
→ The act of stealing certainly doesn’t go against some people’s ethics.
😎
explicit[iksplisit]adj.
If something is explicit, it is very clear, open, and truthful.
→ The man gave a very explicit account of the car accident.
😎
framework[freimwə:rk]n.
A framework is a set of rules or ideas that people use to solve problems.
→ His ideas fit into the framework of a successful business plan.
😎
manufacture[mænjəfæktʃə:r]v.
To manufacture something means to make it in a factory.
→ My father’s company manufactures steel building materials.
😎
mechanism[mekənizəm]n.
A mechanism is a part of a machine that performs a certain function.
→ I can’t open my car door because the locking mechanism is broke.
😎
minimize[minəmaiz]v.
To minimize means to reduce something to the lowest possible level.
→ I checked my homework twice to minimize errors I might have made.
😎
nectar[nektər]n.
Nectar is a sweet liquid produced by flowers that bees and other insects collect.
→ Bees use nectar to make their honey.
😎
notion[nouʃən]n.
A notion is an idea or belief about something.
→ I have a notion that this route would get us to the beach.
😎
prone[proun]adj.
When things are prone to some bad thing, they are likely affected by it.
→ Some people are more prone to catching colds than others.
😎
straightforward[streitfɔ:rwərd]adj.
When something is straightforward, it is good because it is easy to understand.
→ The teacher’s grading system was straightforward and fair.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Choose the answer that best fits the question.

questions.content: What is something you want to eliminate?
questions.explanation: Eliminate có nghĩa là loại bỏ. Bạn muốn loại bỏ một vấn đề (a problem), không phải món quà hay chiến thắng.

questions.content: What would collect nectar?
questions.explanation: Nectar là mật hoa. Ong (bee) là loài thu thập mật hoa.

questions.content: If you have good ethics, you_______.
questions.explanation: Ethics là đạo đức. Nếu bạn có đạo đức tốt, bạn biết phân biệt đúng sai (know right from wrong).

questions.content: Which is most closely related to something administrative?
questions.explanation: Administrative liên quan đến quản lý, hành chính. Tổ chức (organization) là từ có liên quan nhất.

questions.content: What might cause erosion?
questions.explanation: Erosion là sự xói mòn. Một cơn gió mạnh (strong wind) hoặc nước chảy có thể gây ra xói mòn.

sections.title: Exercise 2: Fill in the blanks with the correct words from the word bank.
sections.content: Word bank: cholesterol, prone, framework, administration, explicit, deceptive, coalition, mechanisms, straightforward, manufactures

questions.explanation: Từ vựng phù hợp với ngữ cảnh.

questions.content: The students asked the school’s [ 102 ] to buy a better kind of meat. The meat served there is too high in fat and [ 103 ].
questions.explanation: Từ vựng phù hợp với ngữ cảnh.

questions.content: I can’t stand companies that are [ 104 ]. Customers have to make sure they get [ 105 ] information about all details.
questions.explanation: Từ vựng phù hợp với ngữ cảnh.

questions.content: Citizens formed a [ 106 ] because the city’s air was making people ill. Elderly people and infants were the most [ 107 ] to becoming sick.
questions.explanation: Từ vựng phù hợp với ngữ cảnh.

questions.content: To solve our problem, we’ll first need a strong [ 108 ]. Our ideas need to be intelligent and [ 109 ].
questions.explanation: Từ vựng phù hợp với ngữ cảnh.

sections.title: Exercise 3: Write C if the italicized word is used correctly. Write I if the word is used incorrectly.

questions.content: Smoking makes people more prone to breathing problems.
questions.explanation: Prone to có nghĩa là dễ bị mắc phải. Hút thuốc làm người ta dễ mắc bệnh hô hấp. Dùng đúng (C).

questions.content: We toured the factory that manufactures cheese.
questions.explanation: Manufacture là sản xuất (tại nhà máy). Dùng đúng (C).

questions.content: The deceptive man was very open and honest about his plans.
questions.explanation: Deceptive là lừa dối, không thể miêu tả một người cởi mở và trung thực (open and honest). Sai (I).

questions.content: Eating a lot of fast food raises people’s cholesterol levels.
questions.explanation: Cholesterol là mỡ trong máu. Ăn thức ăn nhanh làm tăng mức cholesterol. Dùng đúng (C).

questions.content: The straightforward instructions were impossible to understand.
questions.explanation: Straightforward là dễ hiểu, rõ ràng. Không thể nói là "impossible to understand". Sai (I).

questions.content: The group decided on a framework for the new project.
questions.explanation: Framework là khuôn khổ, cơ cấu. Dùng đúng (C).

questions.content: Businesses try to minimize the amount of money they can make.
questions.explanation: Minimize là giảm thiểu. Các doanh nghiệp muốn tăng (maximize) chứ không phải giảm số tiền họ kiếm được. Sai (I).

questions.content: He had a notion that the speaker was not really an expert on the subject.
questions.explanation: Notion là khái niệm, ý nghĩ, ý niệm. Dùng đúng (C).

questions.content: The maid used a kind of acid to dissolve the stains on the floor.
questions.explanation: Acid là axit, hóa chất có khả năng phân hủy, hòa tan. Dùng đúng (C).

questions.content: It is important for a judge to have good ethics.
questions.explanation: Ethics là đạo đức. Thẩm phán cần có đạo đức tốt. Dùng đúng (C).

questions.content: Some factories produce energy by burning coalitions.
questions.explanation: Coalition là liên minh, sự liên kết. Không thể "đốt liên minh" để tạo ra năng lượng. Sai (I).

questions.content: The lawyer hoped that the witness would tell an explicit version of the story.
questions.explanation: Explicit là rõ ràng, chi tiết. Lời khai của nhân chứng rõ ràng là phù hợp ngữ cảnh. Dùng đúng (C).

questions.content: My father works in construction while my mom has an administrative job.
questions.explanation: Administrative job là công việc hành chính. Dùng đúng (C).

questions.content: Be sure to eliminate all the ingredients to make a great cake.
questions.explanation: Eliminate là loại bỏ. Không thể loại bỏ tất cả nguyên liệu để làm bánh. Sai (I).

questions.content: Jim receives shots to treat his diabetes. They reduce the sugar in his blood.
questions.explanation: Diabetes là bệnh tiểu đường. Các mũi tiêm giúp giảm lượng đường trong máu. Dùng đúng (C).

questions.content: All of the prisoners formed an administration where they played games.
questions.explanation: Administration là chính quyền, ban quản lý. Tù nhân lập thành ban quản lý để chơi game thì không hợp lý. Sai (I).

questions.content: Dry weather, followed by sudden floods, caused the erosion in the valley.
questions.explanation: Erosion là xói mòn. Lũ lụt bất ngờ gây ra xói mòn trong thung lũng. Dùng đúng (C).

questions.content: The biotechnology company only made things from nonliving rocks and sand.
questions.explanation: Biotechnology là công nghệ sinh học (liên quan đến tế bào sống, sinh vật). Không thể làm từ đá và cát vô tri. Sai (I).

questions.content: The cutting mechanism on the lawnmower is broken.
questions.explanation: Mechanism là cơ cấu, bộ máy. Bộ máy cắt của máy cắt cỏ bị hỏng. Dùng đúng (C).

questions.content: This nectar produces the best flowers.
questions.explanation: Nectar là mật hoa (do hoa tạo ra). Mật hoa không thể sinh ra những bông hoa đẹp nhất. Sai (I).

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
The New Bioco

Jack got a new job at a biotechnology company called Bioco. Bioco manufactured drugs to treat diabetes and high cholesterol. Jack’s job was to use a tiny mechanism to get nectar from flowers. The nectar was a main ingredient in the drugs. Jack liked his job, and he thought that Bioco was a caring company. However, Jack soon learned that the company wasn’t as kind as he first thought.

Bioco’s motto was “Make the Earth a Better Place.” However, this motto was deceptive. The company actually did a number of really bad things to the environment. The company produced a lot of smog and harmful acid. Bioco poured the acid in a nearby river, which caused erosion and made fish prone to illness.

After a few weeks at the new job, Jack saw all the bad things Bioco was doing. He had always had strong ethics, and he knew he had to do something. One day, while the Bioco workers were eating in the cafeteria, Jack stood up and gave a speech. He said, “My fellow coworkers, I know you have all seen the evil things our company is doing. I have a notion that we can fix them if we form a coalition. We can go to the administration and tell them we’ll quit if they don’t eliminate the problems. They’ll have no choice but to listen to us.”

Jack explained what they were to do. His coworkers liked his explicit plan. They went to the administrative offices and demanded that Bioco stop damaging the environment, or they all would quit. One supervisor said to them, “Thank you for being straightforward about this issue. Since I can’t afford to lose all of you workers, I guess we’ll just have to fix things.”

Jack, his supervisor, and his coworkers spent the next month designing a new framework for the company. They cleaned up the acid from the river and minimized the amount of air pollution the company released. At last, the company motto became apt.

sections.title: Part A: Mark each statement T for true or F for false. Rewrite the false statements to make them true.

questions.content: Bioco was a biotechnology company that manufactured diabetes and high cholesterol.
questions.explanation: Trong đoạn 1, bài đọc ghi "Bioco manufactured drugs to treat diabetes and high cholesterol." (Bioco sản xuất thuốc để điều trị bệnh tiểu đường và cholesterol cao). Công ty sản xuất THUỐC ĐIỀU TRỊ hai bệnh đó, chứ không phải sản xuất ra bệnh.

questions.content: Jack used a mechanism to get nectar from flowers.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1 có câu "Jack's job was to use a tiny mechanism to get nectar from flowers." (Công việc của Jack là sử dụng một cỗ máy siêu nhỏ để lấy mật từ những bông hoa).

questions.content: The new framework involved an explicit plan to fix the smog and acid problems.
questions.explanation: Trong đoạn 4 "Jack explained what they were to do. His coworkers liked his explicit plan." và đoạn 5 "Jack, his supervisor, and his coworkers spent the next month designing a new framework for the company. They cleaned up the acid from the river and minimized the amount of air pollution..." Kế hoạch này là để giải quyết các vấn đề trên.

questions.content: The waste acid caused erosion and made fish prone to illness.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 cho biết "Bioco poured the acid in a nearby river, which caused erosion and made fish prone to illness." (Bioco đã đổ axit xuống một con sông gần đó, gây xói mòn và khiến cá dễ bị bệnh).

questions.content: After the company minimized Jack’s ethics, the motto became apt.
questions.explanation: Ở đoạn cuối ghi "They cleaned up the acid from the river and minimized the amount of air pollution the company released. At last, the company motto became apt." (Họ đã dọn sạch axit khỏi sông và giảm thiểu lượng ô nhiễm không khí mà công ty thải ra. Cuối cùng, phương châm của công ty đã trở nên phù hợp). Công ty giảm ô nhiễm không khí chứ không phải làm giảm đạo đức (ethics) của Jack.

questions.content: What was Bioco’s deceptive motto?
questions.explanation: Đầu đoạn 2, tác giả viết "Bioco's motto was 'Make the Earth a Better Place.' However, this motto was deceptive." (Phương châm của Bioco là 'Làm cho Trái Đất trở thành một nơi tốt đẹp hơn'. Tuy nhiên, phương châm này mang tính chất lừa dối).

questions.content: What did Jack stand up to do in the cafeteria?
options: Jack stood up to fight his boss.
Jack stood up to give a speech.
Jack stood up to eat his food.
questions.explanation: Trong đoạn 3, bài có viết "One day, while the Bioco workers were eating in the cafeteria, Jack stood up and gave a speech." (Một ngày nọ, trong lúc các công nhân của Bioco đang ăn trong quán cà phê, Jack đã đứng lên và có một bài phát biểu).

questions.content: What was Jack’s notion about fixing things?
options: He wanted to break the mechanism.
We can fix things if we all work together.
He thought they should just quit.
He wanted to call the police.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3 Jack nói "I have a notion that we can fix them if we form a coalition." (Tôi có một ý nghĩ là chúng ta có thể sửa chữa nếu chúng ta liên minh lại). Việc liên minh lại có nghĩa là tất cả cùng làm việc chung.

questions.content: What did the coalition of workers threaten to do if the administration didn’t eliminate the problems?
options: The workers threatened to sue the company.
The workers threatened to leak the secrets.
questions.explanation: Ở đoạn 3, "We can go to the administration and tell them we'll quit if they don't eliminate the problems." (Chúng ta có thể đến gặp ban quản trị và nói với họ rằng chúng ta sẽ nghỉ việc nếu họ không loại bỏ những vấn đề này). Hành động đe dọa là nghỉ việc.

questions.content: What did the boss in the offices say after the workers were straightforward with him?
options: Since I can’t afford to lose all my workers, I guess we’ll just have to fix things.
He promised to raise their salaries.
questions.explanation: Trong đoạn 4, người quản lý nói "Since I can't afford to lose all of you workers, I guess we'll just have to fix things." (Vì tôi không thể để mất tất cả các bạn công nhân, tôi đoán chúng ta sẽ phải khắc phục mọi thứ).
